integrity: The proof and independently computed projected-hull diagnostics are supplied. Numerical experiments are not continuum proofs; the theorem is self-reviewed only and not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: A deterministic pair-invariant feasible-set theorem for orthogonal planar projections of one circumradius-one regular octahedron; no joint density or nonregular-body generalization is claimed. Historical priority is provisional and depends on future independent literature review.
title: Exact joint area–inradius spectrum and a sharp silhouette-identifiability transition for regular-octahedron shadows
